conclusion: 6-way unification complete. The 7 imaginary octonion units embed into the even-parity class of Q4. The full Q4 Gray clock alternates parity by one-bit steps, while the even octonion frame is its every-other-tick projection with two-bit internal moves. The Fano plane's 7 lines split as 3 timelike (q=3 internal) + 4 spacelike (mu=4 spacetime). This is the first substrate realization of the 3+4=7 internal/spacetime split from a single combinatorial object.
